feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
entry.summary: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.

entry.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
entry.summary: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

entry.title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
entry.summary: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.

entry.title: Judges may face unprecedented decisions this election. A new guide seeks to help
entry.summary: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

entry.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
entry.summary: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

entry.title: Republicans hope unconventional convention will rally voters ahead of midterms
entry.summary: The Republican party is calling it a "Trumpapalooza." The party is throwing an unconventional convention in Dallas this week to try to boost Republican voter enthusiasm.

entry.title: Political commentator on what we might expect from Trump's midterm convention
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with commentator Jonah Goldberg about this week's unusual Republican midterm gathering.

entry.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
entry.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

entry.title: Trump's construction projects are transforming the capital
entry.summary: President Trump is transforming Washington. New York Magazine's Ben Terris says the ballroom, the planned arch and other changes are an attempt to achieve "architectural immortality."

entry.title: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
entry.summary: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.
